title: Defensive Frac & Offset Well Loading
body:
Protecting producing wells during nearby frac activity

The economics of a frac hit are unforgiving. A communicating offset well can lose months of production, force a workover, or in the worst case, change the long-term performance of an asset that was already cash-flowing. Our defensive frac program exists for one reason: protect the wells you're already producing while frac operations move through the area.

What we deliver

  • Pre-frac offset well assessment and load planning—identify risk wells, document baseline conditions, plan loading strategy with the operator.
  • Real-time pressure monitoring during operations—surface pressure, casing pressure, and flow indicators tracked through the frac campaign.
  • Anomaly detection with rapid escalation—pressure communication signatures surface as alerts, not as reading-list items at the end of the shift.
  • Documentation packet supporting regulatory and post-frac analysis—the record your reservoir engineering and legal teams need.

Where it fits

Multi-well pad fracs, infill drilling near producing wells, and any operation where a producing asset sits inside the influence zone of upcoming frac activity.

Why it matters

Frac hits used to be discovered after the fact. Defensive frac programs catch the signature in real time, document what happened, and give engineering and legal a defensible record—whether the goal is to mitigate, recompense, or simply prove what occurred.
